verdict.rationale: Jan documents a Custom Assistants feature for creating specialized AI assistants for specific tasks. Its assistants docs describe per-assistant persona and instructions that can be assigned to a project so every conversation in that project uses them. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of assistant configuration options beyond persona and instructions (e.g., per-assistant model or parameter settings), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can create specialized custom assistants configured for specific tasks

citations.quote: Custom Assistants: Create specialized AI assistants for your tasks
you can assign an assistant to it so every conversation in that project automatically uses your chosen persona and instructions.
